description.narrative: The PDO is to (i) decommission the Komati coal-fired power plant, (ii) repurpose the project area with renewables, and (iii) create opportunities for workers and communities during the transition process.

The development objective of Eskom Just Energy Transition Project for South Africa is to (i) decommission the Komati coal-fired power plant, (ii) repurpose the project area with renewables, and (iii) create opportunities for workers and communities during the transition process. This project has three components. 1) The first component, Komati Decommissioning, has the following sub-components: (i) Subcomponent A.1; and (ii) Subcomponent A.2. 2) The second component, Komati Repurposing, has the following sub-components: (i) Subcomponent B.1.; (ii) Subcomponent B.2; and (iii) Subcomponent B.3. 3) The third component, Opportunities for Workers and Communities, has the following sub-components: (i) Transition Support to Komati Permanent Workers, Suppliers, and Contract Workers; (ii) Community Development and Economic Diversification; and (iii) Stakeholder Engagement and Community Empowerment.

condition.narrative: Covenants under IBRD Loan Agreement : Section I.B.1 of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement: In implementing Part C of theProject, the Borrower shall by no later than ninety (90) days after the Effective Date: (a) hire and maintain at all times duringProject implementation, under terms of reference acceptable to the Bank, service provider(s) (the “Service Provider”) responsiblefor supporting JETO in carrying out and managing the activities under Part C of the Project; (b) enter into an agreement with theService Provider(s) (“Service Provider Agreement”) on terms and conditions satisfactory to the Bank including: (i) supporting theBorrower to coordinate and develop partnerships with other relevant stakeholders and institutions in accordance with theimplementation agreements provided in Section I.B.3 of this Schedule; and (ii) developing procedures for implementing activitiesunder Part C of the Project satisfactory to the Bank including the criteria for selecting beneficiaries and procedures forengagement and decision-making.

Covenants under IBRD Loan Agreement: Section I.A.3 of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement: By no later than ninety (90) daysafter the Effective Date, the Borrower shall hire and maintain at all times during Project implementation, under terms of referenceacceptable to the Bank: (a) an owner engineer responsible for supporting the CEU in connection with Part A.1 of the Project; and(b) an owner engineer responsible for supporting the CEU in connection with Part B.1 of the Project.

Covenants under IBRD Loan Agreement: Section I.D.1 of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement: The Borrower shall, not later thanninety (90) days after the Effective Date, (and thereafter by April 30 of each subsequent Fiscal Year) prepare and furnish to theBank, a work plan and budget containing all activities proposed for implementation in the following calendar year including: (a) adetailed timetable for the sequencing and implementation of said activities; (b) the types of expenditures required for suchactivities, including a proposed financing plan; and (c) a budget establishing the proposed amounts and sources of financing.

Covenants under IBRD Loan Agreement: Section II.A of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement: The Borrower shall furnish to the Bankeach Project Report not later than forty five (45) days after the end of each calendar semester, covering the calendar semester.

Covenants under IBRD Loan Agreement: Section III.D of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement: Specific financial undertakingsregarding the Borrower's financial condition including that the Borrower shall prepare and deliver to the Bank not later than April30, 2023, and thereafter not later than April 30 in each successive Fiscal Year up to and including the Closing Date, interimunaudited financial forecasts for the Borrower, in form and substance satisfactory to the Bank, covering the immediately followingFiscal Year, which forecasts shall include calculations of the Borrower's EBITDA Margin (as such term is defined below in thisSection D) or such other indicator as otherwise agreed with the Bank in writing, as at the end of the next two six month periodswithin the relevant Fiscal Year.

Covenants under the CCEFCF Financing Agreement: Section II.A of Schedule 2 to the CCEFCF Financing Agreement: The Recipient shallfurnish to the Bank each Project Report not later than forty five (45) days after the end of each calendar semester, covering thecalendar semester.
Covenants under the CCEFCF Financing Agreement: Sections I.A.3, I.B.1, I.D.1 and III.D of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreementare incorporated by reference in the CCEFCF Financing Agreement.

Covenants under the ESMAP Grant Agreement: Section II.A of Schedule 2 to the ESMAP Grant Agreement: The Recipient shall ensure thateach Project Report is furnished to the Bank not later than forty five (45) days after the end of each calendar semester, coveringthe calendar semester.
Covenants under the ESMAP Grant Agreement: Sections I.A.3, I.B.1 and I.D.1 of Schedule 2 to the IBRD Loan Agreement areincorporated by reference in the ESMAP Grant Agreement.
